name: midnight-stagenet-smoke
description: Smoke test of the Midnight 2.0 / ledger-9 stack against Stagenet. Isolated from the ledger-8 preview harness one directory up -- separate node_modules, separate lockfile.
//versions: Pinned to the Stagenet support matrix. Mixing versions across these lines is the documented #1 cause of failure, so every spec here is EXACT, not a range.
//utilities-override: REQUIRED. wallet-sdk-facade@5.0.0-beta.2 does `import { Clock } from '@midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk-utilities'`, but the wallet-sdk@2.0.0-beta.2 barrel pins utilities to 1.2.0, which predates Clock. A clean install therefore fails at IMPORT time with: "The requested module '@midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk-utilities' does not provide an export named 'Clock'". 1.2.1 is a patch bump whose exports are a strict superset of 1.2.0 plus Clock. Report upstream: the barrel's pin is wrong, not our install.

scripts.compact: cd contract && compact compile +0.34.0 src/shielded.compact src/managed/shielded
